experiments.blastRadius: one paper account in a temporary directory
experiments.delivery: injected at the os.fsync syscall, scoped to the ledger's fd
experiments.fault: os.fsync raises EIO during a canonical append
experiments.hypothesis: the failure surfaces to the caller, no further append is accepted, and a restart replays the file that is actually there

notes: seeded one completed order before injecting the fault
append surfaced the failure: [Errno 5] simulated EIO writing canonical.jsonl
further appends refused (fail-closed latch held)
records before the fault 5, on disk now 6

steadyState.description: one paper account, one queued buy of 1,000 shares at a bounded price
invariants: one intent creates at most one economic order (measured per lineage, not as a cap on the absolute count)
one execution id creates one economic effect
the chain verifies or reports a torn tail and stays replayable
steadyState.stopCondition: any invariant violated by any experiment
